title: 9 out of 10 is bad
text: 9 out of 10 is bad. These are great except there were only 9 in the package of 10. Obviously, an oversight but pretty careless. Update: I received 6 hooks within two weeks to make up for the missing hooks. Now 5 for 1 is definitely a great improvement.
